content:
Header help menu

Links to Kahana docs, training gallery, theme picker, and account-adjacent actions depending on build.

What this is

The assistant header bundles Help (opens Kahana docs), Training gallery, Theme picker, and account controls depending on build.

How to use it

  • Click the ? or menu icon in the assistant chrome.
  • Choose Documentation to read extended help on the web.
  • Use Themes or Training entries when visible.

Notes and limits

Menu entries can be feature-flagged; missing items mean your build trimmed that surface.
